prompt:
以下はある英語ニュースpodcast記事のFull Story・Point One・Point Twoです。
Point One・Point Twoそれぞれについて、以下6項目を判定してください
(それぞれPASS/FAIL)。

- qa_not_caveat_only: このPointが、研究上の限界・一般化上の注意・免責事項
  だけで構成されていない場合PASS(それらに加えて実質的な新しい内容がある
  場合もPASS。留保だけでPoint枠全体が終わっている場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_full_story_paraphrase: Full Storyの要約・言い換えに留まっていない
  場合PASS(Full Storyの中心的なlogic・結論を語彙だけ変えて繰り返している
  場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_other_point_paraphrase: もう一方のPointの要約・言い換えになって
  いない場合PASS
- qa_explains_why_it_matters: 「だから何なのか」を具体的に説明できている
  場合PASS(聞き手にとっての具体的な意味・示唆がある場合)
- qa_specific_not_generic: この記事のLedger固有の内容に基づいており、他の
  どんな記事にもほぼそのまま流用できる一般論になっていない場合PASS
- qa_adds_new_value: 新しい理解・解釈・意外性・具体的示唆のいずれかを
  実際に加えている場合PASS(Full Storyだけを聞いた場合と比べて、聞き手の
  理解が実際に深まっている場合)

reasoningには、判定理由を1〜2文の日本語で書いてください(特にFAILの場合は
具体的な理由を明記してください)。

【Full Story】
On August 16, 2026, at Mazda Stadium, Hanshin turned an early lead into a win over Hiroshima.

The first big moment came in the opening inning. With a runner on base, Teruaki Sato hit a two-run home run to center field. Hanshin took control before the game had time to settle.

Hanshin starter Rito Ihara gave the lead steady support. He worked five innings and allowed only two hits and one run.

Hiroshima’s only run came in the fifth inning. Elehuris Montero hit a solo home run, but Hiroshima could not add more runs after that.

Hanshin kept moving forward. The Tigers scored again in the seventh and eighth innings. The early advantage became a much bigger gap, and the home team had no answer.

This was not just a game won by one home run. Hanshin started strongly, received a solid outing from Ihara, and added more runs late.

The final score was:

Hanshin 8, Hiroshima 1.

【Point One】
There was one important personal achievement for Hiroshima. Elehuris Montero reached 10 home runs for the first time in his second season in Japan. It did not change the team result, but it shows that one hitter reached a meaningful milestone even while the home team could not produce a larger attack.

【Point Two】
The win also rested on what happened after Ihara left the game. Four Hanshin relievers covered the final four innings. Together, they allowed one hit, no walks, struck out five, and allowed no runs. That clean handoff kept Hiroshima’s only score from creating comeback pressure.
